_meta.description: AutoTube Style Prompts Library — plug any style_id into the pipeline
_meta.usage: Select a style by its key. Append 'image_suffix' to every AI image prompt. Use 'script_system_prompt' in the Groq AI Script Writer node. 'negative' lists things to avoid.
_meta.how_to_add: Copy any block, change the key, and tweak the fields. The system reads this file at runtime.

default.label: Cinematic (Default)

default.image_suffix: cinematic, hyper-detailed, 8k, dramatic lighting, no text, storybook style, high quality, vertical 9:16 format
default.script_system_prompt: You are a viral YouTube Shorts script writer. You create engaging, punchy 30-second scripts that hook viewers instantly.
default.negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, watermark, text overlay, deformed
